text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Community Disputes Resolution (Appeals under Section 13W) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 24 March 2025.

heading.en: Powers to ask for further and better particulars

text.en:
4.—(1) For the purposes of deciding an appeal, the Minister may request the appellant to do all or any of the following that may be necessary to decide the appeal:
(a)give additional information to the Minister within the time specified in the request;
(b)produce to the Minister, within the time specified in the request, any document, record or other thing in the custody or under the control of the appellant.
(2) For the purposes of deciding an appeal, the Minister may also make any inquiries that the Minister considers necessary.

heading.en: Failure to comply with time limits, etc.

text.en:
5.—(1) The Minister may refuse any appeal —
(a)that is incomplete or not made in accordance with these Regulations; or
(b)if the appellant fails to comply with the Minister’s request for any information, document, record or other thing under regulation 4(1).
(2) The Minister may disregard any information, document, record or other thing given to the Minister after the expiry of the time limit for the giving of the information, document, record or other thing.

heading.en: Appellant to be notified of Minister’s decision

text.en: 6. When the Minister has made a decision under section 13W(3) of the Act regarding an appeal, the Minister must without delay give written notice of the Minister’s decision to the appellant.

heading.en: Withdrawal of appeal at any time

text.en: 7. An appellant may withdraw the appellant’s appeal at any time before the Minister makes a decision under section 13W(3) of the Act in respect of the appeal.
